lines.zh: 我在沼泽湿地中自由飞翔，寻找美味的半日花。
lines.en: I soar over the Wetland Mires, searching for the sweet nectar of Halfday Flowers.

lines.zh: 这绳草真柔软，我得试试。
lines.en: This rope grass is soft, I should give it a try.

lines.zh: 远处的落羽杉木好高啊，我得去看看。
lines.en: The落羽杉木 soars high, I should check it out.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛可值钱了，记得别丢。
lines.en: My feathers are valuable, don't lose them.

lines.zh: 柠檬石散发着奇异的光芒，真迷人。
lines.en: The Citrine Stone glows mysteriously, so enchanting.

lines.zh: 寄生蜘蛛总是让我保持警惕。
lines.en: The parasitic spiders always keep me on my toes.

lines.zh: 今天又找到了一个迷宫式地牢的入口。
lines.en: I found another entrance to a Labyrinth Dungeon today.

lines.zh: 这些蘑菇可真独特，要小心采集。
lines.en: These unique mushrooms are a danger to touch.

lines.zh: 鹤群中我是最自由的，我爱这里。
lines.en: I'm the most free among the cranes, I love it here.

lines.zh: 落羽杉木为我遮风挡雨，好安逸。
lines.en: The落羽杉木 shelters me from the wind and rain, it's so comfortable.

lines.zh: 我踩过浅水，惊起一串气泡。
lines.en: I step through the shallows and start a string of bubbles.

lines.zh: 半日花在雾里开得正白。
lines.en: The half-day flowers bloom white in the mist.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，慢慢走过软泥。
lines.en: I lift my feet and wade slowly through the soft mud.

lines.zh: 水下的绳草绊了我一下。
lines.en: The rope grass under the water trips me a little.

lines.zh: 我沿着湿地边缘走，不赶时间。
lines.en: I walk the wetland's edge with no hurry at all.

lines.zh: 落羽杉的影子在水面晃。
lines.en: Bald cypress shadows sway on the water.

lines.zh: 我停在草地上，静静地享受这片刻的宁静。
lines.en: I perch on the grass, enjoying this moment of peace.

lines.zh: 我的同伴们围成一个圈，似乎在商量什么。
lines.en: My companions gather in a circle, as if they're planning something.

lines.zh: 我可以听到远处的水流声，这是大自然的声音。
lines.en: I hear the distant sound of flowing water, the voice of nature.

lines.zh: 我用翅膀扇动一下，为这个区域带来一点清风。
lines.en: I flap my wings, bringing a gentle breeze to the area.

lines.zh: 我静静地观察着，寻找食物，但这里似乎没有。
lines.en: I quietly observe, searching for food, but it doesn't seem to be here.

lines.zh: 我低头看着地面，寻找着可以安家的地方。
lines.en: I look down at the ground, searching for a place to settle.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛反射着阳光，好像在邀请阳光光临。
lines.en: My feathers reflect the sunlight, inviting it to stay.

lines.zh: 我在等待，等待那只寄生蜘蛛的出现。
lines.en: I wait, anticipating the appearance of the parasitic spider.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转动，感受微风带来的凉意。
lines.en: I slowly turn, feeling the coolness of the breeze.

lines.zh: 我享受这片刻的自由，远离尘嚣。
lines.en: I relish this moment of freedom, away from the hustle and bustle.

lines.zh: 我单脚站在浅水里，一动不动。
lines.en: I stand on one leg in the shallows, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 风把羽毛吹乱，我慢慢梳理。
lines.en: The wind ruffles my feathers, so I preen them slowly.

lines.zh: 看着你真想跳舞
lines.en: I wish I could do a little dance for you.

lines.zh: 看这里，我的羽毛
lines.en: Check out these feathers.

lines.zh: 跟我来，安全的地方
lines.en: Follow me to a safer place.

lines.zh: 看我的舞姿，优雅如斯
lines.en: Watch my grace, like a dancer.

lines.zh: 这里的风景美如画
lines.en: The scenery here is a masterpiece.

lines.zh: 和我一起飞翔，自由无边
lines.en: Fly with me, freedom is endless.

lines.zh: 看我的飞翔，翅膀轻盈
lines.en: See my flight, my wings are light.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛，柔软又美丽
lines.en: My feathers, soft and pretty.

lines.zh: 跟我走，安全的地方
lines.en: Come with me, a safer place.

lines.zh: 和我一起，探索沼泽
lines.en: Explore the wetlands with me.

lines.zh: 喙受伤了
lines.en: Beak hurt.

lines.zh: 翅膀疼痛
lines.en: Wings hurt.

lines.zh: 停下，我受伤了
lines.en: Stop, I'm hurt.

lines.zh: 飞不高了
lines.en: Can't fly high.

lines.zh: 好疼啊
lines.en: That really hurts.

lines.zh: 快救救我
lines.en: Help me please.

lines.zh: 羽毛被击落
lines.en: Feathers fell.

lines.zh: 尾巴受伤了
lines.en: Tail hurt.

lines.zh: 视线模糊了
lines.en: Vision blurry.

lines.zh: 翅膀被击中
lines.en: Wing hit.

lines.zh: 靠近我，我可以带你飞越沼泽。Come closer, I can take you soaring over the wetlands.
lines.en: Come closer, I can take you soaring over the wetlands.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛柔软而美丽，可以做饰品。My feathers are soft and beautiful, they can be used for decorations.
lines.en: My feathers are soft and beautiful, they can be used for decorations.

lines.zh: 不要伤害我，我们可以成为朋友。Don't hurt me, we can be friends.
lines.en: Don't hurt me, we can be friends.

lines.zh: 我会指引你，找到回家的路。I can guide you to find your way home.
lines.en: I can guide you to find your way home.

lines.zh: 看看我的羽毛，漂亮吧？Look at my feathers, aren't they beautiful?
lines.en: Look at my feathers, aren't they beautiful?

lines.zh: 我会用美丽的舞蹈吸引你。I'll use my beautiful dance to attract you.
lines.en: I'll use my beautiful dance to attract you.

lines.zh: 你为什么靠近我？Are you scared of me?
lines.en: Why are you getting close to me?

lines.zh: 这里是我的家，不要打扰我。This is my home, don't bother me.
lines.en: This is my home, don't bother me.

lines.zh: 如果你不伤害我，我可以给你指路。If you don't hurt me, I can lead you somewhere.
lines.en: If you don't hurt me, I can lead you somewhere.

lines.zh: 请不要伤害我，我有我的尊严。Please don't hurt me, I have my dignity.
lines.en: Please don't hurt me, I have my dignity.

lines.zh: 我飞过这片布满半日花的沼泽湿地，这里是我温暖的家。
lines.en: I fly over the wetland bog filled with half-day flowers; this is my warm home.

lines.zh: 看到那些绳草吗？它们缠住了好几个寄生蜘蛛。
lines.en: See those rope grass? They have trapped several parasitic spiders.

lines.zh: 这里太美了，我愿意守护它。
lines.en: It’s so beautiful, I’m willing to guard it.

lines.zh: 小心，我可能掉羽毛了。
lines.en: Watch out, I might drop some feathers.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽地牢中，我遇到了鹤朋友。
lines.en: In this swamp dungeon, I met a crane friend.

lines.zh: 我用轻盈的翅膀划过这片土地。
lines.en: I glide my light wings over this land.

lines.zh: 半日花为我遮挡了毒虫。
lines.en: Half-day flowers shield me from poisonous bugs.

lines.zh: 绳草保护了我，也保护了鹤群。
lines.en: Rope grass protected me and the crane flocks.

lines.zh: 这片土地的遗迹中，藏着未知的秘密。
lines.en: The ruins of this land hold unknown secrets.

lines.zh: 我在这里找到了一个安全的栖息地。
lines.en: I found a safe haven here.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣在不远处，我用优美的舞蹈吸引她。
lines.en: My mate is not far, I attract her with a graceful dance.

lines.zh: 我挥动着翅膀，发出悦耳的鸣叫，向我的伴侣示爱。
lines.en: I wave my wings and emit a melodious call, showing my affection to my mate.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛更加闪亮，以表明我对伴侣的爱意。
lines.en: My feathers shine more brightly, signifying my love for my mate.

lines.zh: 我用我的声音和舞蹈，表达了我对伴侣的深深爱意。
lines.en: I express my deep affection through my voice and dance for my mate.

lines.zh: 我们互相鸣叫，仿佛在用声音沟通，分享彼此的情感。
lines.en: We call to each other, communicating through sound and sharing our emotions.

lines.zh: 我用羽毛轻轻触碰她，表达我的爱。
lines.en: I gently touch her with my feathers, expressing my love.

lines.zh: 我们一起飞翔，享受着彼此的陪伴。
lines.en: We fly together, enjoying each other's company.

lines.zh: 在黄昏时分，我们并肩站立，彼此的心更加亲近。
lines.en: At dusk, we stand together, our hearts closer than ever.

lines.zh: 我会用我的羽毛为她做巢，让她更加舒适。
lines.en: I will use my feathers to build a nest for her, making it more comfortable.

lines.zh: 我用我的歌声为她伴奏，希望她能感受到我的爱。
lines.en: I sing for her, hoping she can feel my love.

lines.zh: 我在沼泽上空翱翔，自由自在。Wetland Whimsy:Crane is my name, a friend of the wetlands.
lines.en: I'm soaring in the skies above the wetlands, free and happy. My name is Wetland Whimsy:Crane, a friend of these wetlands.

lines.zh: 这片落羽杉木林是我的家园。这里有我飞翔的天地。This is my home, a forest of落羽杉木, where I soar and fly.
lines.en: This is my home, a forest of落羽杉木, where I soar and fly freely.

lines.zh: 我采集半日花的花粉，为我美丽的羽毛增添光彩。I gather the pollen from the half-day flowers to make my feathers more beautiful.
lines.en: I gather pollen from the half-day flowers to make my feathers more pretty.

lines.zh: 阳光洒在我的羽毛上，如同金色的光芒。阳光照在我的羽毛上, 像金色的光辉。The sun shines on my feathers, like a golden glow.
lines.en: The sun shines on my feathers, like a golden light.

lines.zh: 绳草缠绕着我的脚，我必须小心避开。Rope grass wraps around my feet, I must be careful to avoid it.
lines.en: Rope grass wraps around my feet, I must be careful to avoid it.

lines.zh: 落羽杉的果实滋养了我，让我更加坚强。The fruits of the落羽杉 nourish me, making me stronger.
lines.en: The fruits of the落羽杉 nourish me, making me stronger.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽很美丽，但也很危险。This wetland is beautiful, but also dangerous.
lines.en: This wetland is beautiful, but also dangerous.

lines.zh: 鹤群中的舞蹈是我展示给伴侣的。The dances of the Crane group are a display to my partner.
lines.en: The dances of the Crane group are a display to my partner.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛轻盈又柔软，就像天鹅绒一样。My feathers are light and soft, like velvet.
lines.en: My feathers are light and soft, like velvet.

lines.zh: 我将在这片沼泽中度过我的一生。I will spend my life in this wetland.
lines.en: I will spend my life in this wetland.

lines.zh: 看见了猎物
lines.en: Saw the prey.

lines.zh: 锁定目标了
lines.en: Acquired target.

lines.zh: 锁定了一只小动物
lines.en: Acquired a small animal.

lines.zh: 锁定了一只昆虫
lines.en: Acquired an insect.

lines.zh: 锁定了一只鱼
lines.en: Acquired a fish.

lines.zh: 锁定了一只鸟
lines.en: Acquired a bird.

lines.zh: 锁定了一只兔子
lines.en: Acquired a rabbit.

lines.zh: 锁定了一只松鼠
lines.en: Acquired a squirrel.

lines.zh: 锁定了一只老鼠
lines.en: Acquired a mouse.

lines.zh: 锁定了一只虫子
lines.en: Acquired an insect.

lines.zh: 展翅高飞
lines.en: Soar high

lines.zh: 湿地家园
lines.en: Call wetlands home

lines.zh: 翩翩起舞
lines.en: Dance on wings

lines.zh: 我抬腿，慢慢逼近。
lines.en: I lift one long leg and close in.

lines.zh: 羽毛飘落
lines.en: Feathers fall

lines.zh: 天空之歌
lines.en: Song of sky

lines.zh: 友好的鹤
lines.en: Friendly crane

lines.zh: 自然之灵
lines.en: Nature's spirit

lines.zh: 飞翔自由
lines.en: Freedom to fly

lines.zh: 鹤鸣水面
lines.en: Echoes on the water

lines.zh: 扑向敌人
lines.en: Charge at the enemy

lines.zh: 挥动翅膀
lines.en: Flap wings fiercely

lines.zh: 敏捷地闪避
lines.en: Quickly dodge

lines.zh: 我的喙啄向你的手。
lines.en: My beak jabs at your hand.

lines.zh: 射出羽毛
lines.en: Shoot feathers

lines.zh: 发出尖鸣
lines.en: Scream loudly

lines.zh: 急速降落
lines.en: Descend swiftly

lines.zh: 快速飞翔
lines.en: Fly quickly

lines.zh: 振翅飞翔
lines.en: Beat wings and fly

lines.zh: 优雅地起舞
lines.en: Graceful dance

lines.zh: 看这里，这片沼泽是我们的家。Wetland habitat, home sweet home!
lines.en: Look here, this wetland is our home. Home sweet home!

lines.zh: 这片落羽杉林地是觅食的好地方。Feasting grounds in this l落羽杉 forest.
lines.en: This l落羽杉 forest is a good place for feasting.

lines.zh: 欢迎来到我们鹤族的湿地家园。Welcome to our wetland home, Crane clan.
lines.en: Welcome to our wetland home, Crane clan.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛在阳光下闪耀。My feathers shine in the sun.
lines.en: My feathers shine in the sun.

lines.zh: 小心！我要起飞了。Watch out! I'm taking flight.
lines.en: Watch out! I'm taking flight.

lines.zh: 在这片沼泽湿地，我们自由翱翔。Fly high in this wetland.
lines.en: In this wetland, we fly high.

lines.zh: 这里到处都是我们鹤族的朋友。Friends galore in this swamp.
lines.en: Friends galore in this swamp.

lines.zh: 别怕我，我是这里的和平使者。I'm here in peace, not to cause trouble.
lines.en: Don't fear me, I'm a peace envoy here.

lines.zh: 我的伙伴们在不远处。My companions are nearby.
lines.en: My companions are nearby.

lines.zh: 落羽杉林地，我们的食源所在。This l落羽杉 forest is where we find our food.
lines.en: This l落羽杉 forest is where we find our food.

lines.zh: 被火焰烧伤了，好疼！
lines.en: Burnt by flames! Ouch!

lines.zh: 摔得太狠了，翅膀受伤了！
lines.en: I hit the ground too hard! My wings are injured!

lines.zh: 水塘里呆太久，差点溺死了！
lines.en: Stayed in the pond too long! Nearly drowned!

lines.zh: 被爆炸冲击波震到了，脑袋疼！
lines.en: Exploded nearby! My head hurts!

lines.zh: 箭矢飞来，差点射中我！
lines.en: Arrows flying! I almost got hit!

lines.zh: 黑暗魔法缠身，我感觉自己快不行了！
lines.en: Dark magic surrounds me! I feel weak!

lines.zh: 好久没吃东西了，好饿！
lines.en: I haven't eaten in a while! I'm starving!

lines.zh: 被闪电击中，全身都在颤动！
lines.en: Lightning struck me! I'm trembling!

lines.zh: 虚空之风带走了我的灵魂！
lines.en: Vex wind took my soul!
